title: Weekly train fanout schedule and notes concierge
creator: Diego Morales
description:
Problem: Our current weekly release train has ad-hoc fanout windows and multiple manual touchpoints for RC derivation and release notes aggregation. This leads to inconsistencies in RC tags across lanes, missing changelog entries, and last-minute rollbacks.

Goal: Build a deterministic weekly fanout schedule and an automated 'notes concierge' service that collects PR-level metadata, synthesizes a human-friendly release summary, and attaches it to the RC tag. Ensure deterministic RC derivation so identical input trees yield identical RC tags across regions and runners.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic RC tag creation for weekly candidate builds (same inputs => same tag)
Automated fanout schedule published to team calendar and Slack at start-of-week with pinned rundown
Release notes concierge produces a human-curated summary + machine-readable changelog and attaches to GitHub release for each RC
Canary gating baton process exercised end-to-end in a dry-run without impacting prod lanes
Rollforward/rollback marker flow tested and included in runbook
Metrics dashboard shows per-RC: commit range, blocked PRs, flaky test evidence, and SLO checks
proposed_steps: Design deterministic RC derivation algorithm: canonicalize commit list, sort by timestamp+hash, produce short semantic suffix (RFC note in Confluence)
Implement fanout scheduler microservice that emits a release-baton message to release-train topic at T+0 and windows at T+6h/T+12h
Build notes-concierge lambda to ingest merged PR metadata (labels, changelog fragments, reviewers, risk tags) and produce both human summary and structured changelog.json
Integrate concierge output into CI pipeline: tag RC, create GitHub release draft, attach changelog.json and summary.md, notify #releases Slack channel
Add gating-baton handoff: Canary -> Regional -> Global with explicit votes recorded in the release ticket; implement automated SLO check gate that must pass for promotion
Create rollback marker flow: release marker that triggers automated rollback playbooks (k8s manifests or runtime overrides) and records reason in the RC metadata
Create end-to-end integration tests and a dry-run mode for the release train that simulates promotion without touching production endpoints
Update runbooks and training doc for on-call and release leads; document manual override steps
rollout_gates: Pre-cut: CI integration checks (lint, unit, integration, infra smoke)
Cut-time: deterministic RC derivation step must succeed and produce identical tag across runners
Canary gate: smoke tests and runtime SLOs for 1% traffic lane for 2 hours
Regional gate: regional SLOs and error-rate thresholds checked for 12 hours
Global gate: full traffic promotion once regional gates stable and no high-severity regressions
Manual override: release lead can stop promotion with documented reason and rollback marker
automation_tasks: Fanout scheduler (k8s CronJob -> release-baton topic) + idempotency guarantees
Notes-concierge service (python) with PR metadata enrichment and heuristics for change-type categorization
Release-notes generator action in GitHub that consumes changelog.json and creates draft release
SLO gate lambda that queries tracing/metrics backend and writes gate decisions to the release ticket
Slack/Calendar notifier and ephemeral message flow for release baton handoffs
E2E dry-run workflow job and test harness in CI
